title: SEG Review Event
description: Schema for a ReviewEvent record in the Safety Evidence Graph. Created when a responsible engineer affirms a suspect strong-propagation edge (refines, verifies, implements). Stored in events/review_events.jsonld for queryability. Provenance — who affirmed and when — is derived from git log in repo G. The review event adds queryable structure: which edge was affirmed, in which role, and optionally which sub-hash changed and why.

id.description: Globally unique IRI for this review event. Form: {namespaceBase}/event/review/{edgeLocalId}-{isoTimestamp}.

type.description: Fixed SEG type. Maps to spdx:Annotation with annotationType review on SPDX export.

seg:affirmingEdge.description: IRI of the strong-propagation edge being affirmed. Must resolve to an existing edge in refines.jsonld, verifies.jsonld, or implements.jsonld.

seg:affirmingRole.description: Role in which the affirmer is acting. Free string — role validation is a process concern enforced by tooling and organisational policy, not the schema. Typical values: RequirementsEngineer, SoftwareEngineer, TestEngineer, FunctionalSafetyManager.

seg:subHashChanged.description: Optional diagnostic field indicating which sub-hash changed on the source node, triggering the suspect state. Populated by the notifier. Informs the affirmer's review focus: an apiHash or specHash change suggests intent changed; a bodyHash or implHash change suggests execution changed; both means full review required; none means the edge went suspect due to a dependency change only.

comment.description: Optional free-text reasoning behind the affirmation. Recommended when the affirmation is non-trivial — for example when affirming despite a spec_hash change without updating the test spec.
